description: Request to list data access requests for the current user

nextPageToken.description: The token to get the next page of results.

sortBy.description: Optional field to sort results by. If omitted, results are sorted by submission modified date.

sortDirection.description: Optional sort direction. Defaults to DESC if omitted.

isEDuc.description: Optional filter. When true, only requests that use the eDUC flow are included; when false, only requests that do not. If omitted, requests are included regardless of whether they use the eDUC flow.

accessRequirementId.description: Optional filter. When set, only requests for the given access requirement are included. If omitted, requests for all access requirements are included.
